tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default ground: cards, modals, inputs, tables, the teacher app body. Text on it: `ink` (15.4:1) and `ink-muted` (6.6:1).

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards in the teacher dashboard and the faux page behind student overlays. `ink` 14.5:1, `ink-muted` 6.2:1.

tokens.name: surface-sky
tokens.usage: Light-blue panels: sidebar, selected rows, brand panels, the locked screen ground. `ink` 13.5:1, `ink-muted` 5.7:1, `brand-strong` 5.3:1.

tokens.name: sky-200
tokens.usage: Soft brand fill: progress tracks, heatmap low end, decorative blocks. `ink` 11.4:1, `brand-strong` 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sky-300
tokens.usage: Decorative blue for illustration and heatmap mid-tones. Never carries text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The CheatNoNo light blue. Logo, large display accents, icons and charts (3.4:1 on white, so graphics and text at 24px+ only). Not a fill for small white text: use `brand-strong`.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and link text. White on it 6.1:1; on `surface-tint` 5.7:1; on `surface-sky` 5.3:1.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of `brand-strong`; white text on it 8.2:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-strong`, `brand-deep`, `danger` and `success` fills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Navy. All primary text, the logo wordmark, dark brand blocks and the overlay scrim. 15.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, helper text on `surface`, `surface-tint` and `surface-sky` (5.7:1 at the lowest).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card borders. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and switches (3.2:1 on white, 3.0:1 on `surface-tint`).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, offset 2px. 6.1:1 on white, 5.3:1 on `surface-sky`.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Fresh accent for illustration, the cover and success moments in graphics. Never carries text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Strike and caution signal: pips, HUD warning dot, warning icon fill. Text on it: `ink` (8.2:1). Never as text on white.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners and the Warned chip.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `warning-bg` (6.8:1) and on `surface` for warning labels.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Locked state, final-warning icon, destructive buttons. Text on `surface` 5.6:1; white text on it 5.6:1.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of danger banners and the Locked chip; `danger` text on it 4.8:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Active, healthy, detected. A teal, deliberately off the red-green axis. Text on `surface` 5.9:1; white on it 5.9:1. Always paired with the word or a check icon.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Active chip and success banners; `success` text on it 5.1:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind student warning cards (78% `ink`). Student overlay cards sit on it; the page behind is also blurred.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Sign-in headline and onboarding hero on desktop. 36px on phones.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles in the teacher dashboard and overlay titles. 24px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and every input (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels at medium size.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text, secondary copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, table headers and eyebrows; set in uppercase for headers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Domains, timestamps, question numbers and the exam timer.
